command:
set -euo pipefail
    cd "$1"
    for pass in 1 2 3; do
        if ! pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error \
            -file-line-error -no-shell-escape whitepaper.tex \
            >"pdflatex-pass-${pass}.log" 2>&1; then
            cat "pdflatex-pass-${pass}.log"
            exit 1
        fi
    done
    pdfinfo whitepaper.pdf
